audit.why: EVEN at 51.4% over 6199 games. Lane is decided by Charm (12s flat) uptime; Lissandra owns level 6, Ahri owns the item-scaling side lane and teamfight pick game.
audit.corrected: Kept diff EVEN / 5.5-10; sharpened the prose to name Charm's flat 12s clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: phases[4..6].side all read 'Skill' while win[4]='Lissandra', win[5]='Ahri', win[6]='Ahri' (packet levelChart agrees with the content layer).
audit.why: Full layer was stale. Packet + content both give Lissandra level 6 and Ahri the two item rows. Spikes: Lost Chapter, level 6 Frozen Tomb (120/100/80), Ahri first item + Spirit Rush charges, Zhonya's.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[4].side to Lissandra, phases[5]/[6].side to Ahri with matching ratings and rewritten whys; win[] already carried the correct values so no cross-layer disagreement is introduced.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Charm 'instantly stops movement abilities', which cancels Lissandra's E (Glacial Path) transport mid-flight. Also unstated: Orb of Deception's return deals true damage, so MR does not answer her poke, and Essence Theft heals her chip back.
audit.why: Riot text on Ahri E says movement abilities are instantly stopped; Riot text on Ahri Q says true damage on the way back; Ahri P heals on minion and champion takedowns.
audit.corrected: Wrote the E-cancel into content.mid and enemyWin, the true-damage-through-MR point into enemyWin, and Grievous Wounds into spikes[2].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Charm is 12s flat at every rank; Spirit Rush is 140/120/100 and refunds recasts on a takedown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 19 misgendering fields (Ahri called he/his/him) and two copy-paste bleeds where tradeGood/tradeBad were pasted verbatim under unrelated Do's/Don'ts titles.
audit.corrected: All pronouns corrected; both bled bullets replaced with content matching their titles.

edits.before: His burst needs a clean window — your root and tomb make every window cost a health bar.
edits.after: Her burst needs Charm first — your root and tomb make every window cost a health bar.

edits.before: Turn his kill windows into tomb refunds, then out-pick him in every river. Shorthand: Charm down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Turn her Charm windows into tomb refunds, then out-pick her in every river. Shorthand: Charm on 12s, wave right, go.

edits.before: Ahri wins by landing Charm, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Ahri wins by landing Charm at 975, then Orb of Deception — the true-damage return ignores the MR you bought.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: Q-shatter her wave contact, and when she steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.

edits.before: - Lissandra vs Ahri - Track: Ahri Charm. - Hold W for his gap-close — the root IS the matchup. - Fights start when Charm ends. - The R is for endings, not openings.
edits.after: - Lissandra vs Ahri - Track: Ahri Charm (12s). - Hold W for her Spirit Rush — the root IS the matchup. - Fights start when Charm ends. - The R is for endings, not openings.

edits.before: Q-shatter the wave and chip his melee step-ups — your early Q harass is better than the lane gives it credit for.
edits.after: Q-shatter the wave and chip her when she walks up to last-hit — her Orb pushes the wave, so let it and punish the step.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q spam stops hurting your mana. Chip Ahri every time he touches the wave.

edits.before: - Ahri Charm: matchup-defining — The charm starts every kill pattern — stay behind minions while it is up. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ahri Charm: 12s flat at every rank — that is the lane clock; stay behind minions until it is spent, then step. - Spirit Rush is 140/120/100 and refunds recasts on a takedown. - Guard your R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay skill-based: your Q poke and W slow answer her Orb, and at 6 your R is a far more reliable point-and-click lock than her Spirit Rush, giving you the edge if you can flash-E or E-flash onto her.
